label: Illustrative, authored from public trial information
short_title: Rilvegostomig vs pembrolizumab, each with platinum + pemetrexed, first-line non-squamous NSCLC (ARTEMIDE-Lung03)
why_chosen: Recruiting industry Phase 3 with a single-population design (hand-encoded, design single_population). Its registry entry states the dosing day for every drug (Day 1 of each 21-day cycle, platinum up to 4 cycles, pemetrexed maintenance), the clearest public schedule among recruiting first-line chemo-immunotherapy Phase 3s, and the backbone matches the Regeneron trial so the two term sheets are comparable.

assumptions: The registry does not publish a schedule of assessments. Visit windows, lab panels and imaging cadence are authored from standard NSCLC practice and common first-line industry protocol design, not copied from the protocol.
Priced regimen: carboplatin or cisplatin + pemetrexed for 4 cycles, then pemetrexed maintenance, as the registry states.
Study drugs supplied by the sponsor are never billed; only their administration appears.
The registry names PFS per RECIST 1.1 but not a blinded central review, so no central scan upload is scheduled.
Tumor assessments every 6 weeks to week 48, then every 9 weeks (common first-line design; the registry is silent on cadence).
